_comment_variant: HYDRA Variant E — Strategy E 'SPY Double Calendar' (OptionsKit, video GuI-hH_jhlg): a multi-day SPY double calendar (net-debit call calendar above spot + put calendar below spot, same strike per leg). MANAGED, not transformed — laddered early profit-taking + a trading-day time-exit, NO hard stop (defined risk = the debit). DRY-RUN-LOCKED. The strategy class (bots/hydra/spy_double_calendar_strategy.py:SpyDoubleCalendarStrategy) refuses any non-dry_run construction; the dry-run lifecycle IS implemented (opens calendars simulated from real mids, scales out on the profit ladder, time-exits before the short expiry, persists across restarts, settles as a backstop) but places NO real orders. brandon.enabled=false so E runs its own (CalendarStrategyBase-derived) path. alerts + google_sheets are OFF so E never pollutes the canonical record or pages the operator. Do NOT flip dry_run=false next to a live C until the coexistence MUST-FIXes ship AND SPY American early-assignment + dividend handling is built (go-live gates) — see the module docstring.
_comment_credentials: IBKR OAuth credentials are loaded from systemd $CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY on the VM, or env vars in dev. Not in this file.

strategy._comment_strategy_name: Selects SpyDoubleCalendarStrategy via the registry (bots/hydra/registry.py). brandon.enabled=false below so the registry resolves strategy.name, not brandon.
strategy.name: spy_double_calendar
strategy._comment_symbols: SPY is an American-exercise, dividend-paying ETF (sec_type STK). underlying_symbol/trading_class drive the option-chain reads; volatility_symbol stays VIX (a fine SPY IV proxy since SPY tracks SPX). NYSE is SPY's primary listing; if the VM's chain reads need ARCA/SMART instead, adjust here (config is skip-worktree'd on the VM).
strategy._comment_spy_double_calendar: Strategy-E-specific knobs (consumed by SpyDoubleCalendarStrategy). Short leg ~35 DTE (± tolerance), long leg = short + ~7 days (± tolerance), same strike per leg. Strikes are expected-move based: call ≈ spot + em_fraction×EM, put ≈ spot − em_fraction×EM (em_fraction 1.0 = ±1 SD). Low-IV entry gate: enter only when VIX <= max_vix_entry (a proxy — true IV-rank vs a 1-yr median is a go-live refinement). Management: laddered profit-taking (close a cumulative share of the original contracts as the return-on-risk crosses each rung), plus a trading-day time-exit that closes ALL remaining contracts within time_exit_days_before trading days of the short expiry (never hold through expiry). NO hard stop.
strategy._comment_contracts: 1c while E is a dry-run scaffold (start small). Raise deliberately only after the lifecycle is paper-verified.
strategy._comment_bp_calendar: ORDER-004 BP floor for a SPY double calendar (defined risk = the net debit paid). SPY notional is far smaller than SPX, so the per-calendar floor is modest. Read by CalendarStrategyBase._min_buying_power_per_unit.

brandon._comment: OFF on E — E is its own (CalendarStrategyBase-derived) multi-day strategy, not the Brandon iron-condor stack. Disabling here makes the registry resolve strategy.name='spy_double_calendar'.

google_sheets._comment: OFF on E (scaffold/dry-run) — E must not write to the canonical Sheets record.

alerts._comment: OFF on E (scaffold/dry-run) — avoids alert spam and operator paging. NOTE: CRITICAL/HIGH alerts still publish via the L-C2 severity bypass even when disabled; E's dry-run path emits none, but keep this in mind before enabling real-order E.

_comment_api_pacing: 2.5 (gentler than C's 2.0) because a real double-calendar would fetch TWO-expiration chains + intraday monitoring — extra load on the shared calypso-broker session. Conservative for the dry-run shadow.
